title.zh: 移民与关卡局长期服务与良好行为奖章规则 2013
title.en: Immigration & Checkpoints Authority Long Service and Good Conduct Medal Rules 2013

completenessNote: 全文，共 24 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 3 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Rules may be cited as the Immigration & Checkpoints Authority Long Service and Good Conduct Medal Rules 2013 and shall be deemed to have come into operation on 1st April 2013.

3. A medal to be designated and styled the Immigration & Checkpoints Authority Long Service and Good Conduct (10 Years) Medal may be awarded to an eligible person in recognition of his long and exemplary service and good conduct in the Immigration & Checkpoints Authority, subject to the minimum requirement specified in rule 4.

4.—(1) An eligible person shall qualify for the award of the 10 Years Medal if he has completed at least 10 years of continuous and unbroken qualifying service.
(2) A Clasp may be awarded to a recipient of the 10 Years Medal on his completion of at least 15 years of continuous and unbroken qualifying service and a second Clasp on his completion of at least 20 years of continuous and unbroken qualifying service.
(3) A period shall be treated as continuous and unbroken for the purposes of paragraphs (1) and (2) notwithstanding —
(a)a break in service of not more than one day for the purpose of awarding a pension or gratuity under the Pensions Regulations set out in the First Schedule to the Pensions Act (Cap. 225);
(b)any period of leave without pay, except that such period of leave shall not be counted as qualifying service;
(c)any period of disruption from full-time or part-time service, except that such period of disruption shall not be counted as qualifying service; or
(d)any transfer without any break in service between the Immigration & Checkpoints Authority, the Singapore Armed Forces, the Singapore Civil Defence Force and the Singapore Police Service.

5.—(1) The 10 Years Medal shall consist of a five-petal fused with a pentagon shaped medal with radiating lines in 925 sterling silver and shall measure 40 mm in diameter and 3 mm in thickness.
(2) The obverse side of the Medal shall bear the Singapore State Crest encircled by the inscription “IMMIGRATION & CHECKPOINTS AUTHORITY” above the State Crest and the inscription “SINGAPORE” beneath the State Crest.
(3) The reverse side of the Medal shall bear the Immigration & Checkpoints Authority Crest encircled above by the inscription “LONG SERVICE AND GOOD CONDUCT”.
6. The 10 Years Medal shall be of the design set out in the First Schedule.

7.—(1) The 10 Years Medal shall be worn by the recipient on the left side of the outer garment suspended by a ribbon measuring 33 mm in width and 50 mm in length.
(2) The ribbon shall have vertical stripes in blue, red and white.
(3) The centre of the ribbon shall have a blue stripe of 9 mm in width, flanked on each side by a red stripe of 4 mm in width, followed by another blue stripe of 3 mm in width, a white stripe of 2 mm in width and another blue stripe of 3 mm in width.

8. A medal to be designated and styled the Immigration & Checkpoints Authority Long Service and Good Conduct (30 Years) Medal may be awarded to an eligible person in recognition of his long and exemplary service and good conduct in the Immigration & Checkpoints Authority, subject to the minimum requirement specified in rule 9.

10.—(1) The 30 Years Medal shall consist of a 5-pointed star medal fused with a faceted pentagon plated in 24K gold and shall measure 45 mm in diameter and 3 mm in thickness.
(2) The obverse side of the Medal shall bear the Singapore State Crest encircled by the inscription “IMMIGRATION & CHECKPOINTS AUTHORITY” above the State Crest and the inscription “SINGAPORE” beneath the State Crest.
(3) The reverse side of the Medal shall bear the Immigration & Checkpoints Authority Crest encircled below by the inscription “LONG SERVICE AND GOOD CONDUCT (30 YEARS)”.
11. The 30 Years Medal shall be of the design set out in the Second Schedule.

12.—(1) The 30 Years Medal shall be worn by the recipient on the left side of the outer garment suspended by a ribbon measuring 33 mm in width and 50 mm in length.
(2) The ribbon shall have vertical stripes in red, blue and white.
(3) The centre of the ribbon shall have a red stripe of 7 mm in width, flanked on each side by a blue stripe of 4 mm in width, followed by a white stripe of 2 mm in width, another red stripe of 1 mm in width, another white stripe of 2 mm in width and another blue stripe 4 mm in width.

12A. A medal to be designated and styled the Immigration & Checkpoints Authority Long Service and Good Conduct (35 Years) Medal may be awarded to an eligible person in recognition of his long and exemplary service and good conduct in the Immigration & Checkpoints Authority, subject to the minimum requirement specified in rule 12B.
[S 497/2014 wef 01/07/2014]

12B.—(1) An eligible person shall qualify for the award of the 35 Years Medal if he has completed at least 35 years of continuous and unbroken qualifying service.
(2) A Clasp may be awarded to a recipient of the 35 Years Medal on his completion of at least 40 years of continuous and unbroken qualifying service.
(3) A period shall be treated as continuous and unbroken for the purposes of paragraphs (1) and (2) notwithstanding —
(a)a break of service of not more than one day for the purpose of awarding a pension or gratuity under the Pensions Regulations set out in the First Schedule to the Pensions Act (Cap. 225);
(b)any period of leave without pay, except that such period of leave shall not be counted as qualifying service;
(c)any period of disruption from full‑time service, except that such period of disruption shall not be counted as qualifying service; or
(d)any transfer without any break in service between the Immigration & Checkpoints Authority, the Singapore Armed Forces, the Singapore Civil Defence Force and the Singapore Police Service.
[S 497/2014 wef 01/07/2014]

12C.—(1) The 35 Years Medal shall consist of a diamond‑shaped medal with interspersed radiating lines plated in 24K gold and shall measure 47 mm in diameter and 3 mm in thickness.
(2) The obverse side of the Medal shall bear the Singapore State Crest encircled with the inscription “IMMIGRATION & CHECKPOINTS AUTHORITY” above the State Crest and the inscription “SINGAPORE” beneath the State Crest.
(3) The reverse side of the Medal shall bear the Immigration & Checkpoints Authority Crest encircled below with the inscription “LONG SERVICE AND GOOD CONDUCT (35 YEARS)”.
[S 497/2014 wef 01/07/2014]

12D. The 35 Years Medal shall be of the design set out in the Third Schedule.
[S 497/2014 wef 01/07/2014]

12E.—(1) The 35 Years Medal shall be worn by the recipient on the left side of the outer garment suspended by a ribbon 33 mm in width and 50 mm in length.
(2) The ribbon shall have vertical stripes in red, blue and white.
(3) The centre of the ribbon shall have a red stripe of 5 mm in width, flanked on each side by a blue stripe of 4 mm in width, followed by a white stripe of 1 mm in width, another red stripe of 3 mm in width, another white stripe of 2 mm in width, and another red stripe of 4 mm in width.
[S 497/2014 wef 01/07/2014]

heading.en: Medals to be awarded by Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Home Affairs

text.en:
13. The 10 Years Medal, 30 Years Medal, 35 Years Medal and Clasp shall be awarded by the Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Home Affairs, on the recommendation of the Commissioner of Immigration & Checkpoints Authority.
[S 497/2014 wef 01/07/2014]
14. The name of any person to whom the Medal or Clasp is awarded shall be published in the Gazette.

15.—(1) The Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Home Affairs, may forfeit any Medal or Clasp awarded to any person under these Rules if the person —
(a)is dismissed or dishonourably discharged from service in the Immigration & Checkpoints Authority;
(b)is convicted of any criminal offence; or
(c)is guilty of misconduct or disloyalty to Singapore.
(2) Any Medal or Clasp forfeited may be restored by the Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Home Affairs, on the recommendation of the Commissioner of Immigration & Checkpoints Authority.
(3) A notice of the forfeiture or restoration of any Medal or Clasp shall be published in the Gazette.

16.—(1) The loss or destruction of the Medal or Clasp shall, if the replacement is desired, be reported by the recipient to the Commissioner of Immigration & Checkpoints Authority who may, if the Commissioner of Immigration & Checkpoints Authority is satisfied that the circumstances in which the loss or destruction occurred are such as to justify replacement, approve the replacement subject to payment made by the recipient to cover the cost of replacement thereof.
(2) No such report shall be made until 6 months after the recipient first becomes aware of the alleged loss or destruction.
